At just 40 calories, this simple yet delicious drink features organic apple juice blended with water and a touch of citric acid. Available across the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks), it provides a wholesome alternative to sugary sodas and complements any meal from the [full CAVA menu](/). This kid-friendly favorite fits seamlessly into balanced dining choices.
